title: Baker Foundation Professor Charles M. Williams Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus
bio: The free, online Job Design Optimization Tool (JDOT) can be used to design, or test the design of, any job in any organization. Use the tool with the following guide: Strategy Execution Module 10: Using the Job Design Optimization Tool to Build Effective Organizations .

Williams Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus Read more Robert Simons is a Baker Foundation Professor at Harvard Business School. For over 35 years, Simons has taught accounting, management control, and strategy execution courses in both the Harvard MBA and Executive Education Programs. For 2024/25, he is teaching a second-year MBA course titled “Changing the World: Life Choices of Influential Leaders,” for which he has authored 23 new case studies available at Harvar
